description: Create a style kit in this project: rules (English text), palette (#RRGGBB) and up to three reference images taken from this project's own images (image ids). Free, no model call. Set als_standard to make it the project default, which then runs in every image and clip of the project (switch it off per call with ohne_stil_kit).

als_standard.description: Make this kit the project default

bild_ids.description: Up to 3 image ids of THIS project

regeln.description: Style rules in English, e.g. 'cold moonlight, deep blue shadows, film grain'

name: lab_create_stil_kit
title: Create Style Kit
